title: Turkey shepherds pie
ingredients: parsley paprika garlic chives on top and cheese on top lightly, creamed potatoes very smooth yukon gold, low fat sour cream, low fat vegetable broth. Garlic, parsley with immersion blender. Mix meat with carrots, onion, celery, sliced mushrooms
